title: Photo sharing at high scale
content: For photo sharing with 100K+ users, route metadata API calls through API Gateway, process uploads with Lambda, store objects in S3, and persist metadata in DynamoDB.

title: Booking workload with transactional constraints
content: Use API Gateway and EC2 application services when workload is steady and transaction-heavy. Prefer RDS for relational consistency requirements in bookings and inventory.

title: Realtime analytics ingestion
content: Realtime ingestion can start with API Gateway and Lambda, writing event summaries to DynamoDB and raw payloads to S3 for downstream analytics and archival.
